validate.title: Validate your e-invoice - jasy
validate.description: Check any ZUGFeRD or XRechnung invoice against the KoSIT EN 16931 rules and veraPDF - free, from any tool. The file is checked and deleted at once, nothing is stored.
validate.label: free validator · official rules · nothing stored
validate.intro: jasy generates ZUGFeRD and XRechnung e-invoices in pure TypeScript. You shouldn't take our word that they're conformant, so don't. Drop in {any} e-invoice below, made by any tool, and check it against the official rules: KoSIT's EN 16931 business rules and veraPDF, the reference validator for PDF/A.
validate.outro: This is the exact check jasy runs on every invoice it generates. Build conformant e-invoices in pure TypeScript.

footer.tagline: PDFs and ZUGFeRD / XRechnung e-invoices in pure TypeScript, with no headless browser and no Java.
footer.built: Built with Nuxt · self-hosted fonts · no trackers

validator.dropHint: A ZUGFeRD or XRechnung PDF (or the raw XML), made by any tool. Or click to choose.
validator.privacy: processed in memory · never stored · deleted instantly
validator.errorUnreachable: We couldn't reach the validator. Please try again in a moment.
validator.errorSample: Couldn't load the sample invoice. Please try again.
validator.invalid: Not valid · {n} issue | Not valid · {n} issues
validator.footnote: Validated with veraPDF, the PDF Association's official open-source PDF/A validator, and the EN 16931 (KoSIT) business rules. jasy only runs them - the verdict is theirs.
